title: Puck in the Car
text: You can now talk to Puck in your car, so you can work more safely while driving without looking at a screen. In the rare case that you do need to look at something, it's displayed very big so a quick glance is enough. The Amp apps for iPhone and Android will automatically enter car mode if you use them there. If you have a Tesla or any other device that can browse the web in your car, open ampcode.com/car. (If you have kids in the car, they might enjoy throwing Puck in the air. Puck likes this.) See more in the Puck in the Car docs.
